conventions.rates: integer basis points (1 bp = 0.01%); phase-in coefficients also in bps (0.6 = 6000)
conventions.dates: ISO 8601; effectiveTo null = in force / latest published (open-ended)
conventions.effectiveDating: Select the row whose [effectiveFrom, effectiveTo] contains the wage month (CPF OW) or the AW payment date (CPF AW). effectiveFrom null means the start date was not verified: apply it only if status is 'in_force' (or 'current' in FWL/work-pass rows), i.e. in force since an unverified historic date. Rows with status 'announced' (or effectiveFromUnknown=true together with status 'announced') must NEVER be applied automatically. Rows with status 'scheduled' have an officially published start date and apply automatically from effectiveFrom.

owCeiling.note: 2027 rate tables (published) still state 'OW ceiling of $8,000'.

annualSalaryCeiling.note: AW ceiling = $102,000 - total OW subject to CPF for the calendar year; per employee, per employer, per calendar year. effectiveFrom for $102,000 is from memory (2016) - only the current value is verified.

awCeilingRule.estimation: At each AW payment use current-year estimated OW (actual OW to date + projected OW for remaining months of expected employment). Recompute with actual OW in the last month of employment or in December (whichever earlier); pay shortfall / apply refund.
awCeilingRule.rateForAw: Rate table and age band in force in the month the AW is paid (shortfalls on earlier AW use the rate of the month that AW was paid).

wageBandBasis.rule: Wage band (NIL / EMPLOYER_ONLY / PHASE_IN / FULL) is chosen on the employee's total wages for the calendar month BEFORE AW capping (OW+AW paid). Formulas are then applied to wages subject to CPF.
wageBandBasis.sourceDetail: AW ceiling examples PDF, example 16 note

rounding.total: ROUND_HALF_UP_TO_DOLLAR on the exact (unrounded) amount: drop cents < 50, round up cents >= 50
rounding.owAndAwSameMonth: compute total and employee on (OW subject + AW subject) together, then round once

ageBandRule.rule: New rates apply from the first day of the month after the month of the employee's 55th/60th/65th/70th birthday; the birthday month itself still uses the younger band.
ageBandRule.algorithm: milestoneMonth(N) = (birthYear+N, birthMonth); band index = count of N in [55,60,65,70] with wageMonth > milestoneMonth(N)

sprYearRule.rule: Year 1: SPR date to last day of the month of the 1st anniversary. Year 2: 1st day of following month to last day of month of 2nd anniversary. Year 3+: thereafter.
sprYearRule.algorithm: y1End=(sprYear+1, sprMonth); y2End=(sprYear+2, sprMonth); wageMonth<=y1End -> 1; <=y2End -> 2; else 3
sprYearRule.conversionMonth: OW: only the pro-rated OW from the SPR date is subject. AW: subject only if paid on/after SPR date.

notes: CPF rounding: total = round half up to dollar on the EXACT amount (drop cents < 50); employee = floor to dollar; employer = total - employee. Do not pre-round to cents (interpretation of CPF wording 'amounts less than 50 cents'; see test vectors RD-03/RD-04; to be confirmed in CPF calculator).

CPF wage band is chosen on total wages paid in the month before AW capping (CPF AW examples PDF, example 16). Unresolved: pre-cap TW in $500-$750 band only due to non-subject AW - engine should apply formulas to subject TW and warn.

CPF AW uses the rate table and age band of the month the AW is PAID; when earlier AW is re-subjected after AW-ceiling recomputation, use the rate of the month that AW was paid (AW examples 11, 13, 14). When one month's shortfall mixes rate tables, CPF rounded the combined exact total once (example 14).
CPF Tables 2 and 3 (SPR G/G) publish 'Above 65' as one band; this file repeats that row for ABOVE_65_TO_70 and ABOVE_70 (publishedAgeLabel = ABOVE_65).
